name: The Brand Story Canvas
diagnostic: How does our brand narrative guide the customer through their struggle against an obstacle toward an altered state of success?
artifact: A Single-Page Strategic Storyboard: Protagonist → Inciting Incident → External/Internal Conflict → The Guide → The Action Plan → The Climax → The New Status Quo.
trap: Making the company the hero of the story rather than positioning the customer as the protagonist and the brand as the guide.
pedigreeFull: Narrative systems practice, translating classical dramatic screenwriting structures into corporate strategy design.
